notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Elections page section 'ELECTION RESULTS & INFORMATION' lists, for each target election, only official files: 2024 general 'NC Official Summary Results 11052024.pdf' and 'NC Official Precinct Summary Results 11052024.pdf'; 2026 primary 'Official Summary Results 03032026 canvassed.pdf' and 'Official Precinct Summary Results 03032026 canvassed.pdf'; 2026 runoff 'NC Official Summary Results 05262026.pdf' and 'NC Official Precinct Summary Results 05262026.pdf', plus reconciliation and audit forms. The runoff heading reads 'OFFICIAL RESULTS OF THE JOINT PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION - MAY 26, 2026' while its Spanish line still reads '(RESULTADOS NO OFICIALES DE LA SEGUNDA VUELTA ...)', which suggests unofficial files were posted and later replaced; their content and timing cannot be read now. The page also links the SOS results site ('TEXAS ELECTION RESULTS'). PDFs not opened since titles mark them as canvassed/official. Check 3 pending: origin/wayback-data not present. En dash in the quoted heading replaced with a hyphen. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-I): No change. Upload times: runoff official summary and precinct files Jun 5 2026, primary canvassed precinct file Mar 27 2026; the runoff preliminary reconciliation form was uploaded 8:50 PM CDT on election night but holds ballot counts, not candidate totals. Three requests for likely unofficial file names (NC Unofficial ... 05262026, Unofficial Precinct Summary Results 03032026) returned 404. Wayback harvest was robots-blocked or unreachable for co.nolan.tx.us; no sweep file; web search for Sweetwater/Nolan precinct results found nothing.
